body.name: Deterministic regular tail
body.construction: \(N_0=\min\{N\in2\mathbb N:\text{ for every }n\in2\mathbb N\text{ with }n\ge N,\ \lambda_{\min}(S_{xx,n})\ge c_x/2,\ v_n\ge c_s/2,\text{ and }\#\{w\in\mathcal A_n:\|n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n(2w_i-1)S_{xx,n}^{-1/2}x_{ni}\|^2\le a\}\ge1\}\). Every inverse, whitened score, standardized score, algorithm, and asymptotic claim is indexed only by even \(n\ge N_0\); the finitely many rows \(n<N_0\) are discarded and have no asymptotic role.
